revision: 1. Preserve the dominant sphere and right control column, but make Conway structure visually credible: organize cells on a clean curved lattice, create clustered live/dead neighborhoods and a few emergent forms rather than uniform scatter, label topology as seamless spherical wrap, and tie generation/running indicators visibly to the simulation. 2. Mask grid and cells precisely to the sphere, resolve the limb and right-side falloff with a controlled rim, and split orbital lines into deliberate behind/front segments. Standardize discrete cell size, opacity, and glow states by the existing five palette roles. 3. Bind title and visualization data into one left region by aligning Orbital Life above the sphere and grouping active cells, density, and topology directly below. Within the panel, reduce the generation number, group each label/value tightly with its custom-styled slider, distribute sections on one vertical rhythm, and keep Pause primary over Reseed. 4. Carry the simulation identity into controls only through restrained cellular state patterns, evolving swatches, or a generation pulse; do not add libraries, 3D engines, or generic telemetry decoration.
conflicts: A visible lattice and neighborhood clusters are necessary for Game of Life intent, but too much grid contrast would obscure the beautiful sphere; use a subtle curved lattice and emphasize only live structures.
Expressiveness wants organic generative controls, while craft requires a disciplined scientific panel; introduce cellular motifs only in swatches/status, not every component.
The generation value is meaningful but currently outranks adjustable controls; retain it as status while reducing its scale and tightening control grouping.
rationale: I preserved the striking visualization while replacing decorative randomness with legible automaton structure and extending that logic into a cleaner, more coherent control hierarchy.
